# VFawn Contributor Agreement

**Version 1.1 · Effective 2026-10-13**

This English text is the controlling version of the VFawn Contributor
Agreement. It supersedes, in its entirety and for all purposes, any prior
version of this agreement issued in any other language.

This Agreement is entered into between **You** (the "Contributor") and
**VFawn** ("We", "Us" or "VFawn"), meaning the VFawn team, its legal entity
or entities, and the GitHub organization `vfawn`, together with all project
repositories published under it (collectively, the "Projects").

By submitting any Contribution to a Project, You accept and agree to be bound
by this Agreement. **No Contribution will be merged into a Project unless and
until You have signed this Agreement.**

## 1. Definitions

**"Contribution"** means any work of authorship, and any expression thereof,
that is first submitted by You to a Project and that We accept or have reason
to accept, including any modifications, additions, or deletions to the source
code, documentation, tests, build and configuration files, designs, and any
original content You submit through issues, pull requests, mailing lists, or
code review. For the avoidance of doubt, "Contribution" does not include
works that are clearly separate from the Projects, such as code You maintain
in an independent repository that has not been purpose-built for integration
with the Projects.

## 2. Copyright

### 2.1 Assignment

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, You hereby **assign to
VFawn, outright and irrevocably**, the entire copyright and all related
economic rights subsisting in the Contributions — including the rights to
reproduce, distribute, rent, communicate and make available to the public,
adapt, translate, and otherwise exploit the Contributions, and all other
present and future rights of any kind — **worldwide, in perpetuity, and with
full title guarantee**. The assignment takes effect upon creation of each
Contribution and applies retrospectively to every Contribution You have
previously submitted. This Agreement constitutes the written instrument required in jurisdictions
that demand written form for the assignment of present and future copyright.

### 2.2 Moral Rights

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, You waive, and agree not
to assert against VFawn or its licensees, all moral rights (including rights
of paternity and integrity) that You may hold in the Contributions. Where
such rights cannot be waived under the law of a jurisdiction (including most
civil-law jurisdictions), You instead consent to any act or omission by
VFawn and its licensees in relation to the Contributions that would otherwise
infringe those rights, including the identification or non-identification of
You as the author and any modification, adaptation, or publication of the
Contributions for any purpose of the Projects.

### 2.3 License Fallback

Solely to the extent that the assignment in Section 2.1 or the waiver or
consent in Section 2.2 is unenforceable in a jurisdiction, You grant to VFawn,
its licensees, and all recipients of software distributed by VFawn a
**perpetual, irrevocable, non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free copyright
license** to reproduce, prepare derivative works of, publicly display,
publicly perform, **sublicense**, and distribute the Contributions and such
derivative works, in source code, object code, or any other form. This
license is sufficient in scope to support both the community licensing of the
Projects and VFawn's commercial licensing of the Projects, in each case
without further permission from You.

### 2.4 Community License Outbound

VFawn will make the Contributions available to the public under the Projects'
open-source license (currently GPL-3.0-or-later, or any later version VFawn
adopts), so that You and all members of the public may use, modify, and
redistribute the Contributions on those terms.

This Agreement operates within the framework of the international copyright
treaties to which the parties' jurisdictions subscribe, including the Berne
Convention and the TRIPS Agreement, and nothing in it limits any right You
enjoy under those treaties.

## 3. Patent License

### 3.1 Grant

Subject to Section 3.2, You hereby grant to VFawn, its licensees, and all
recipients of software distributed by VFawn a **perpetual, irrevocable
(except as stated in Section 3.2), worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free
patent license** to make, have made, use, offer to sell, sell, import, and
otherwise transfer the Contributions and derivative works thereof, where the
license is limited to those patent claims You own or have the right to
license that are necessarily infringed by the Contributions or by their
combination with the Projects.

### 3.2 Defensive Termination

The patent license in Section 3.1 terminates automatically, prospectively and
retroactively, as to You alone, if You institute patent litigation (including
a cross-claim or counterclaim in a lawsuit) alleging that a Contribution, or
the Projects, constitutes direct or contributory patent infringement. This
Section 3.2 does not affect the copyright assignment or copyright licenses in
Section 2, which remain irrevocable.

## 4. Representations and Warranties

You represent and warrant that:

1. You have reached the age of majority and have the legal capacity and full
   right, power, and authority to enter into and perform this Agreement; if
   You sign on behalf of a legal entity, You are duly authorized to bind it;
2. You are the author of the Contributions or have otherwise lawfully
   acquired the entirety of the rights assigned or licensed under this
   Agreement;
3. to Your knowledge, entering into and performing this Agreement does not
   violate any agreement with any third party, and Your submission and
   disclosure of the Contributions does not breach any confidentiality
   obligation;
4. to Your knowledge, the Contributions do not infringe any patent,
   copyright, trademark, trade secret, or other right of any third party;
   and
5. for Contributions created in the course of employment or commission, You
   have obtained all authorizations from Your employer or commissioning party
   necessary to grant the rights in this Agreement.

## 5. Disclaimer of Warranties; Limitation of Liability

Except as expressly set forth in this Agreement, the Contributions are
provided "AS IS". Neither You nor VFawn makes or receives any other
warranties or conditions, express, implied, or statutory. To the maximum
extent permitted by applicable law, neither party shall be liable for any
indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, or consequential damages arising
from or relating to this Agreement or the Contributions.

## 6. Electronic Signature

1. This Agreement may be executed **electronically**. Your click-through
   confirmation, performed through Your GitHub account following OAuth
   identity verification on the signing bot deployed by VFawn (CLA
   Assistant), constitutes Your valid electronic signature of this Agreement
   and has the same force and effect as a handwritten signature. The parties
   agree that this Agreement is concluded and signed in electronic form in
   accordance with the UNCITRAL Model Law on Electronic Signatures (2001) and
   applicable electronic transaction laws.
2. The signature record — GitHub account identifier, associated commit email
   addresses, timestamp, and agreement version — is retained by the bot and
   is publicly verifiable as evidence of execution. You shall ensure that the
   email addresses used in Your Git commits are associated with the signing
   GitHub account.
3. When a new version of this Agreement is published, a contributor who has
   signed a prior version must sign the new version before further
   Contributions can be merged; the publication of a new version does not
   affect any assignment or license already made under a prior version.

## 7. Term

This Agreement takes effect upon Your electronic signature and continues in
perpetuity. It is **irrevocable** and shall not terminate by reason of Your
departure from the Projects, deletion of Your account, or any subsequent
expression of intent. It binds Your heirs, executors, administrators, and
assignees, and inures to the benefit of VFawn and its successors and assigns.

## 8. Amendments and Notices

Amendments to this Agreement are published as a new version in a Project
repository and take effect for You upon Your signature of that version; no
amendment affects any assignment or license already completed. Notices
relating to this Agreement may be given through the public channels of the
Projects.

## 9. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution

This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising out of it are
governed by the laws of **England and Wales**, without regard to its conflict
of laws rules. Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this
Agreement shall first be sought to be resolved amicably; failing resolution
within thirty (30) days, the dispute shall be finally resolved by
**arbitration administered by the London Court of International Arbitration
(LCIA)** under the LCIA Arbitration Rules, with the seat of arbitration in
**London**, the language of the arbitration in **English**, and a sole
arbitrator. The award is final and binding on the parties and may be enforced
in any court of competent jurisdiction pursuant to the 1958 New York
Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards.

## 10. General

1. If any provision of this Agreement is held unenforceable in a
   jurisdiction, that provision is unenforceable only in that jurisdiction,
   and the remainder of the Agreement remains in effect, with the unenforceable
   provision replaced by an effective provision that most closely achieves
   its intent;
2. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement of the parties with
   respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous
   understandings, whether oral or written;
3. No failure or delay by either party in exercising any right operates as a
   waiver of that right; this Agreement may be assigned by VFawn in whole or
   in part together with any merger, acquisition, or transfer of the
   Projects;
4. Nothing in this Agreement creates any employment, agency, partnership, or
   joint venture between You and VFawn;
5. This Agreement is executed in the English language, and the English text
   controls exclusively.

---

**How to sign**: When you open a pull request against any Project repository,
the signing bot will present this Agreement for signature; completing the
GitHub-verified click-through executes it.
